source.snippet: I wish there was a tool that also displayed current and accumulated transfer rate per socket/process. I use jnettop for this purpose, but I'm unhappy with its user interface.

problem_statement: Developers monitoring network activity lack a single tool that combines per-socket/process transfer rate (current and accumulated) with a modern, usable terminal UI — existing tools like jnettop are functionally adequate but have poor UX.
target_segment: Linux/macOS developers and sysadmins doing network diagnostics on the command line
notes: Single HN comment but reflects a gap that tools like nethogs/jnettop partially fill without satisfying users. Opportunity is a polished TUI network monitor with per-socket bandwidth accounting.
